title: 892. Valid Permutations for DI Sequence

examples.explanation: Five of the 24 orders obey down-up-down.

hints: Let dp[i][j] count ways for the prefix ending with rank j among the first i+1 values.
For an I step, dp[i][j] is the prefix sum of dp[i-1] below j; for a D step it is the suffix sum above j-1. Use running sums modulo 1e9+7.
